searchText: I'm pretty happy with the general state of 2718 and 2711 at the moment. If I don't hear any significant feedback by about next week I propose we push both toward the core devs in an all core devs call. Anyone want to volunteer to champion either or both in a core devs call (I can never make the calls). I can champion them in ACD <@!301186049323958275> Do we want a transition period for 2718 where we accept both legacy and typed transactions ? Like we have in 1559 It is a breaking change for wallet and client implementers so maybe it would help to have a smooth transition I believe the idea is that nodes can convert legacy txs to type 0 txs, where type 0 txs have the same hashing procedure as the legacy ones this will avoid breaking wallets So we don't include the transaction type in the signature if type == 0 ? Ok that makes sense. Thank you It seems 2718 would be super helpful if we don't want to bundle EIP 1559 and the escalator Should EIP 1559 and escalator require 2718 ? We could have type 1 = EIP 1559 alone, type 2 = Escalator alone, type 3 = EIP 1559 + escalator Don't know if it brings too much complexity though Still better than guessing the type with different RLP decoding IMO I don't have enough context on the discussion around the escalator, but yes I think that 2718 will make things like that much easier Will raise this in the <#692078615269212180> i have asked to discuss 2718 at the next 1559 implementers call but any feedback in the meantime would be great Oh yeah i saw in the agenda
